summary: I build AI agents and modernization tools that help clients understand complex systems, make sense of their data, and improve how they work. I bring 11+ years of client-facing engineering, from discovery workshops to full-stack applications and cloud delivery. I work across React interfaces, Python services, and data pipelines; spawn and coordinate specialized agents; and connect enterprise tools through MCP. I extend agent harnesses with reusable skills and hooks, and use LLM evaluations, tracing, and guardrails to build reliable workflows with human review and answers we can verify.
title: Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Engineer
